verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at help.puzzle.io (HTTP 200) that indexes the Puzzle Help Center, and individual help articles are served as .md files, so an agent can be pointed at the docs. Coverage is limited to end-user help content: the root docs-md path returned 404, no OpenAPI or swagger spec was found at any candidate path, and nothing shows agent-oriented API or developer docs. missing for 10: agent-oriented API/developer documentation (no OpenAPI spec found), a documented first-party llms.txt / llms-full.txt policy beyond the help-center index, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
